row_target.description: False alarms an hour the alarm on every tick may raise on the calibration set.

row_k.description: The k of the last `n` rows that alarm is held to its target at.

n.description: The rows the alarm looks back over.

onnx_files.description: The `onnx/<time>` or `quantize/<time>` directory the models scored as, or null for torch.

precision.description: The precision of those ONNX files, or null for torch.

scores.description: The scores of the calibration set the thresholds were taken from.

models.description: The directory the models came from.

onnx_files.description: The ONNX files the models scored as, as the scores record them. Null when the models scored in torch.

calibration_set.description: The calibration set the rows came from, as the scores record it.

log_split.description: The log split, as the scores record it.

grid.description: The grid, as the scores record it.

min_speed.description: The speed a row had to exceed to set a threshold.

rows.description: How many scored rows each threshold was taken from.
